statement: Let u : V → T be a surjective mor- phism with connected fibres, where V is normal projective and T is smooth projective. Let ∆ ≥ 0 be a Q-divisor such that (V, ∆) is log canonical. If the log canonical divisor of the geometric generic fibre G is big and κ(T) ≥ 0, then κ(V, KV + ∆) ≥ dim G + κ(T).
